hero_title: The commercial bridge between Brazil's food industry and global buyers.

about_p1: JJ2 bridges world-class Brazilian food producers and global buyers across Europe, Asia, the Americas, and the Middle East.
about_p2: Through active participation in APEX-Brasil business rounds and major trade fairs (Anuga, SIAL, Gulfood), Juliano Canato and Julio Lima guarantee commercial transparency, regulatory compliance, and long-term contract predictability.
about_why1: Direct factory access — transparent pricing, no unnecessary intermediary markups.
about_why2: Compliance audit — HACCP, SIF, Halal, Kosher and ISO certifications verified.
about_why3: Logistics optimization — FCL container loading, palletizing, export documentation.
about_why4: Executive matchmaking — direct negotiation with Juliano & Julio in English, Spanish or Portuguese.
